title: Historical Emuera distribution archives: public catalog

scope.location_description: Preserved local copies of historical Emuera distributions
scope.included_content: Per-archive SHA-256, MD5, format, size, upload number, distribution URL candidate, and nested file-level inventory

provenance.source: ux.getuploader.com/ninnohito (era community public upload site, referenced from the community bulletin board)
provenance.collection: All 208 archives were downloaded from the public upload site; filenames preserve the original upload numbers as saved by the collector.
provenance.url_rule: 保存名の先頭番号を https://ux.getuploader.com/ninnohito/download/<番号> に対応させた候補。owner report describes a common acquisition process; a generated mapping is not an individually observed page.

url_source_legend.prefix_generated: 保存名の番号から生成し、所有者報告の取得手順と対応付けた候補
url_source_legend.observed_page: 該当個別ページを取得して名前・掲示MD5と保全物の実測を照合済み

listing_observation.method: 先行する一覧ページ1回の取得。今回はサイトへアクセスしない。
listing_observation.mapping_limit: 前回の保存出力は表示名8種類とリンク件数のみを記録し、15個の個別リンクと表示名の対応や生HTMLを保存していない。同名v17の番号を一覧表示から特定しない。

provenance.note: This public catalog is a derivative of a private catalog with personal-path and owner-voice descriptions removed. Technical per-file data is preserved as recorded.
